title: KnowledgeDelegation
description: A delegation issued to the knowledge service: the person's active agent, the knowledge packs its template allows, and a Microsoft Graph token that names both the agent and the person. It was authorised at the moment of the request and its evidence is recorded; the knowledge service uses it for one retrieval and asks again for the next.

agentIdentity.description: The agent's Entra agent identity (object id).

person.description: The HR person the agent acts for.

packs.description: The knowledge packs of the agent's effective template. Retrieval never reaches outside them.

graphToken.description: Delegated Microsoft Graph access token. A credential: never log or store it.
